title: The Wine That Climbs the Glass: The Physics of Wine Tears
summary: This episode explains how wine swirled in a glass climbs up the glass wall as a thin film, against gravity, and then slides back down in droplets, known as the tears of wine. It explains the mechanism: alcohol evaporates faster at the edge, which creates a difference in surface tension, and that difference pulls the liquid upward. The episode runs from James Thomson's first explanation in eighteen fifty-five to Carlo Marangoni's eighteen sixty-five thesis, and on to twenty twenty, when Bertozzi and his team modeled the climbing film as a shock
